name: @jeldon/verify
description: Domain-agnostic citation verification + citation linting. Pluggable ClaimVerifier (NullVerifier default, Cite8Verifier health plugin, PrimarySourceVerifier generic) + lintCitations driven by the citation policy in the Domain Pack.
